title: Annihilape re-test and Sleep Suspect Test
summaryHTML: National Dex Champions OU will be suspecting sleep and annihilape. To qualify as a voter, you must reach 1200 on the ladder this season before Sunday 5th July 22:00 GMT +1. There is no requirement to make a new account for this suspect test, those who have already reached 1200+ ELO are pre-qualified to vote.
author: Rasche
